name: list_payees
description: List the household's saved payees (name, category, payeeId, UPI ID).

name: lookup_bill
description: Look up the amount due on a saved biller payee. Returns amount, due date and any message from the biller.

name: pay_upi
description: Send money by UPI to a saved payee (payeeId) or to any UPI ID (vpa). Amount in rupees.

payeeId.description: A saved payee's payeeId, or empty.

vpa.description: A UPI ID like name@bank, if not a saved payee.

name: add_payee
description: Save a new payee for the household.

name: request_approval
description: Ask the family approver to approve something.

name: alert_family
description: Send an alert to the family approver.
